# Clarify | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning | Autonomous CRM based on AI workload, with sales agents, conference intelligence, automatic slotting and continuous updating of transactions at its core. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | HF meetings and automation may result in fluctuations in costs over time; Growth level SSO, relocation and custom object borders need pre-contract confirmation. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | High-frequency conferencing and automation may cause costs to fluctuate with usage; Growth-class SSO, migration, and custom object boundaries need to be confirmed before signing. |
